units.source_text: 直到深秋，相似的事情发生了好几次。

en.t: Until late autumn, similar things happened several times.

units.source_text: 渐渐地，信子创作小说的时间越来越少，丈夫也对她谈论的文学不再感兴趣。

en.t: Gradually, Nobuko had less and less time to write fiction, and her husband no longer showed interest in the literature she talked about.

units.source_text: 每晚，他们对着火盆坐着，也就是讲讲家庭琐事来打发时间，

en.t: Every night, they sat facing the brazier and passed the time by talking about household trifles,

units.source_text: 而且丈夫小酌后似乎对这些话题更感兴趣。

en.t: and after a little drink, her husband seemed even more interested in such topics.

units.source_text: 信子谨小慎微的观察丈夫的深色，可是丈夫似乎没有察觉，

en.t: Nobuko cautiously watched her husband's expression, but he seemed not to notice,

units.source_text: 咬着最近新留起来的胡须，比以往更加愉快，沉吟的说：“那么之后，我们生个孩子如何……”

en.t: biting the mustache he had recently begun to grow, and looking more cheerful than before, he said thoughtfully, "After that, how about us having a child..."
